questions.prompt: Why can a reified type parameter be used in an is check?
questions.answer: The inline call substitutes the concrete type at the call site
questions.explanation: Normal JVM generics are erased, while an inline reified function can place the actual type into generated call-site code.

questions.prompt: What does === test for ordinary Kotlin objects?
questions.explanation: Referential equality asks whether two references designate the same object, unlike structural equality with ==.

questions.prompt: Spot the boundary bug: val name: String = javaUser.name; return name.length
questions.answer: The unannotated Java platform value may be null but is forced into a non-null Kotlin type
